title: How It Works – ThePaymaster®
heading: How It Works
body:
YOUR JOURNEY WITH THEPAYMASTER®

Welcome to ThePaymaster®. We’ve designed our process to be clear, secure and efficient – transforming complex payment distributions into straightforward steps.

Here’s how we’ll work together:

1. Initial Briefing & Evaluation (30 Minutes)

Book your video briefing through our online calendar. We’ll ask for some basic details to prepare:

  • Total amount to be distributed
  • Expected transfer date
  • Number of recipients
  • Nature of the underlying transaction

During this recorded call, we’ll:

  • Learn about your completed, or impending project
  • Understand your distribution requirements
  • Provide our initial evaluation
  • Guide you through next steps
  • Answer any questions

2. Documentation Phase

After our call, simply email your supporting documents to

briefus@thepaymaster.co.uk such as:

  • Profit share agreements
  • Commission structures
  • Background information discussed during our call

3. Verification Process

Once we’ve reviewed your documentation:

For Senders:

  • Complete our speedy KYC/KYB verification through Sumsub
  • Confirm and verify source of funds from the transaction
  • Sign the Sender’s Paymaster Agreement via DocuSign
  • Receive your unique Transfer Reference Code

For Recipients:

  • Complete our speedy KYC/KYB verification through Sumsub
  • Confirm banking details
  • Sign the Recipient’s Authorisation via DocuSign

4. Fund Transfer & Distribution

The process flows smoothly from here:

  1. Sender transfers funds using their unique Reference Code
  2. Sender notifies ThePaymaster® of the transfer
  3. ThePaymaster® confirms receipt to all parties
  4. Distributions are processed to recipients
  5. ThePaymaster® notifies everyone of the transfers
  6. Recipients confirm receipt
  7. Optional: Transaction NFTs issued to verified digital wallets

Our Commitment to You

At each stage, we maintain clear communication and full transparency.

Like watching your journey progress on a map, you’ll always know exactly where you are in the process. Ready to begin? Book your briefing call today.

Trust in every transaction. Confidence in every step.
